gloss: wrong guess; off the mark; mistaken

definitions.gloss: wrong guess; off the mark; barking up the wrong tree
definitions.explanation: A mistaken assumption, guess, or direction of thinking. Indicates that someone's understanding or approach is fundamentally misguided.

examples.japanese: それは{見当違|けんとうちが}いだ。
{見当違|けんとうちが}いの{方向|ほうこう}に{努力|どりょく}していた。
examples.english: I was putting effort in the wrong direction.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}を{見当違|けんとうちが}いの{人物|じんぶつ}だと{思|おも}い{込|こ}んで{捜査|そうさ}を{進|すす}めていた。
examples.english: They had been proceeding with the investigation thinking the culprit was the wrong person.

notes: Can function as a na-adjective: {見当違|けんとうちが}いな{意見|いけん} (a misguided opinion), {見当違|けんとうちが}いな{批判|ひはん} (misdirected criticism). The word {見当|けんとう} means "estimate" or "guess" and appears in: {見当|けんとう}がつく (to have a rough idea), {見当|けんとう}がつかない (to have no clue). Common pattern: {見当違|けんとうちが}いも{甚|はなは}だしい (utterly mistaken). Related: {的外|まとはず}れ (missing the point — similar meaning), {勘違|かんちが}い (misunderstanding — a simpler, more common word for everyday mistakes).
